synopsis: The second cour of Futsutsuka na Akujo de wa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den . Through the actions of Reirin and Keigetsu, the series of disturbances caused by a curse in the inner court have settled down. Through their swap, Reirin and Keigetsu learned of each other’s character, and a friendship was budding between the two of them. Seasons pass, and we are now at early autumn. The location of the ritual where the Crown Prince and the Maidens wish for a bountiful harvest (the Harvest Festival) has been set within the southern lands ruled by the Shu clan. With no consort as guardian, Keigetsu arduously continues with preparations despite feeling the pressure as the host of the Harvest Festival.
